data.notes: October 2026 is anchored by Strip residencies and arena-level concerts rather than a confirmed destination festival calendar, with major rock, pop, R&B/funk, Latin, and classical dates already on sale.

events.title: Metallica: Life Burns Faster
events.summary: Metallica opens its Life Burns Faster residency at Sphere with an explicitly listed October 1, 2026 performance. The Sphere run is billed around the band’s No Repeat Weekend format.

events.title: Scorpions – Coming Home to Las Vegas
events.venueName: PH Live at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino
events.summary: Scorpions return to PH Live for a Las Vegas residency running September 17 through October 3, 2026, with Buckcherry as special guest. Confirmed October performances are October 1 and October 3.

events.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd
events.summary: Lynyrd Skynyrd is confirmed for Pearl Concert Theater at Palms Casino Resort on October 3, 2026. The AXS listing gives an 8:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: Ludovico Einaudi: Solo Piano
events.venueName: Encore Theater at Wynn Las Vegas
events.summary: Composer and pianist Ludovico Einaudi performs a solo piano concert at Wynn Las Vegas’ Encore Theater on October 7, 2026. Wynn lists the show at 8:00 p.m.

events.title: Juanes – North America Tour 2026
events.summary: Juanes brings his North America Tour 2026 to Pearl Concert Theater on October 10, 2026. The AXS event page lists an 8:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: Earth, Wind & Fire at The Venetian Theatre
events.venueName: The Venetian Theatre at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
events.summary: Earth, Wind & Fire return to The Venetian Theatre for a nine-show limited engagement from October 16 through October 31, 2026. The announced dates include October 16, 17, 18, 21, 23, 24, 28, 30, and 31.

events.title: Rise Against with Alkaline Trio
events.summary: Rise Against’s Ricochet 2026 tour stops at Pearl Concert Theater on October 17, 2026, with Alkaline Trio listed on the bill. AXS lists the concert at 7:00 p.m.

events.title: Taking Back Sunday with Thrice and Saves The Day
events.summary: Taking Back Sunday plays Pearl Concert Theater on October 18, 2026, with Thrice and Saves The Day also listed. The AXS page confirms a 7:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: Donny Osmond Residency
events.venueName: Harrah's Showroom at Harrah's Las Vegas
events.summary: Donny Osmond’s long-running Las Vegas residency has a confirmed October 9, 2026 performance at Harrah’s Showroom. The Ticketmaster listing gives a 7:30 p.m. show time.

events.title: Doja Cat – Tour Ma Vie World Tour
events.summary: Doja Cat’s Tour Ma Vie World Tour is confirmed for T-Mobile Arena on October 31, 2026. The official arena listing places the show in Las Vegas on Halloween night.
